query: INSERT INTO access_group_members (group_id, user_id, tenant_id, source) SELECT g, $2, $3, 'sso' FROM unnest($1::uuid[]) AS g ON CONFLICT (group_id, user_id) DO UPDATE SET source = CASE WHEN access_group_members.deleted_at IS NULL THEN access_group_members.source ELSE 'sso' END, deleted_at = NULL, deleted_by = NULL, delete_reason = NULL
